test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

By hook or by crook

options.text: Using a lot of energy and effort to do something
Probably possible, but it will be difficult

solution:
The correct answer is **__Using whatever methods are necessary.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **idiom **is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words
 
• The idiom** By hook or by crook** means achieving something by any possible method
 
• *Example *: I have to top in the exam** by hook or by crook.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Some more **idiom **are :

 
• **Oddball **- a strange person or oddo.

*Example *: The new girl in class is an **oddball**

 
• **Down to Earth** - sensible and realistic

*Example *: Even after being so rich she is **down to earth.**

 
• **Cheapskate **- someone who dislikes spending money.

*Example *: My mother is a **cheapskate**.
